baking_tools.definition: Items used for baking, including cake tins and cookie cutters.
baking_tools.boundary: Includes baking pans, moulds, and cutters; excludes general kitchen utensils (kitchen_tools) and disposable paper cases (cake_cases).

bath_beauty.definition: Towels, soap holders, and bath sponges used for personal care in the bath or shower.
bath_beauty.boundary: Includes bath linens and bath accessories; excludes kitchen textiles (kitchen_textiles) and tissues (tissues_plasters).

bunting_garland.definition: Decorative strings of flags or paper shapes used to adorn spaces for celebrations.
bunting_garland.boundary: Includes paper or fabric garlands and bunting; excludes individual hanging ornaments (hanging_ornaments).

cake_cases.definition: Disposable paper or foil cups used to line muffin or fairy cake tins.
cake_cases.boundary: Includes baking paper liners; excludes reusable cake tins (baking_tools) and paper napkins/cups (party_tableware).

cake_stand.definition: Elevated plates or stands used to display and serve cakes and desserts.
cake_stand.boundary: Includes glass, metal, or ceramic cake stands; excludes general serving plates (plates) and tabletop decorations (tabletop_decorations).

candle_holder_lantern.definition: Holders, plates, or lanterns designed to safely contain candles or tea lights.
candle_holder_lantern.boundary: Includes candle plates and tea light holders; excludes string lights (lights_lamps) and incense holders (incense).

incense.definition: Incense sticks, cones, or sets used to release fragrance when burned.
incense.boundary: Includes incense with holders or candles in sets; excludes candle holders without incense (candle_holder_lantern) and scented candles alone.

clocks.definition: Timepieces designed for wall or tabletop display.
clocks.boundary: Includes wall clocks and table clocks; excludes watches or alarm clocks not intended as decor.

clothing_slippers.definition: Wearable items such as slippers, sock puppets, and scarf knitting kits.
clothing_slippers.boundary: Includes slippers, soft sock puppets, and knitting kits for scarves; excludes hand warmers (hand_warmer) and purses/wallets (purse_wallet).

cushions_textiles.definition: Removable fabric covers designed to fit over cushion inserts.
cushions_textiles.boundary: Includes decorative cushion covers only; excludes filled cushions, throws, and kitchen textiles.

doormats.definition: Mats placed at entrances to wipe shoes and protect floors.
doormats.boundary: Includes indoor/outdoor doormats; excludes bath mats and pet mats.

doorstops_paperweights.definition: Weighted items used to hold doors open or keep papers in place.
doorstops_paperweights.boundary: Includes decorative doorstops and paperweights; excludes tabletop decorations (tabletop_decorations) not designed as weights.

egg_cups.definition: Items used to hold boiled eggs upright or cover them to keep warm.
egg_cups.boundary: Includes egg cups and knitted/felt egg cosies; excludes general kitchen tools (kitchen_tools) and tableware (plates).

furniture_knobs.definition: Small freestanding or wall-mounted storage furniture pieces such as cabinets and cupboards.
furniture_knobs.boundary: Includes decorative storage cabinets with drawers; excludes wall shelves/hooks (hooks_racks_shelves), storage baskets, and separate furniture knobs/handles.

garden_outdoor.definition: Decorative and functional items for gardens and outdoor spaces, such as birdhouses, plant cages, and garden markers.
garden_outdoor.boundary: Includes garden ornaments and plant holders; excludes indoor vases/planters (vases_planters) and pet bowls (pet_items).

gift_boxes.definition: Decorative boxes used to present gifts, sometimes with a small item included.
gift_boxes.boundary: Includes pre-filled gift boxes; excludes gift wrap/tags (gift_wrap_tags) and decorative storage boxes (trinket_jewellery_box).

gift_wrap_tags.definition: Wrapping paper, tape, and tags used to wrap and label gifts.
gift_wrap_tags.boundary: Includes rolls/sheets of wrap and gift tags; excludes gift boxes (gift_boxes) and greeting cards (greeting_cards).

greeting_cards.definition: Cards with messages or images sent for occasions and celebrations.
greeting_cards.boundary: Includes single cards and packs; excludes gift tags (gift_wrap_tags) and postcards.

hand_warmer.definition: Portable items that generate heat to warm hands, often reusable.
hand_warmer.boundary: Includes pocket warmers and reusable hand warmers; excludes gloves and clothing/slippers (clothing_slippers).

hanging_ornaments.definition: Decorative items designed to be suspended, typically for seasonal or festive display.
hanging_ornaments.boundary: Includes Christmas tree ornaments and hanging decorations; excludes garlands (bunting_garland) and tabletop decorations (tabletop_decorations).

tabletop_decorations.definition: Freestanding small decorative objects for display on tables, shelves, or mantels.
tabletop_decorations.boundary: Includes figurines and small seasonal decorations; excludes hanging ornaments (hanging_ornaments) and candle holders (candle_holder_lantern).

storage_baskets_decor.definition: Woven or wicker baskets used for storage, picnics, or decorative display.
storage_baskets_decor.boundary: Includes picnic baskets and nesting baskets; excludes kitchen storage containers (kitchen_storage) and laundry baskets.

hooks_racks_shelves.definition: Wall-mounted or hanging hardware for hanging and storing items such as coats, keys, and magazines.
hooks_racks_shelves.boundary: Includes coat hooks, shelving units, and magazine racks; excludes freestanding cabinets (furniture_knobs) and doorstops.

hot_water_bottle.definition: Containers filled with hot water and often covered with fabric, used to provide warmth.
hot_water_bottle.boundary: Includes hot water bottles with covers; excludes hand warmers (hand_warmer) and cushions.

jumbo_shopper_bag.definition: Large reusable bags designed for shopping and carrying groceries or goods.
jumbo_shopper_bag.boundary: Includes cotton or fabric shopper bags; excludes lunch bags (lunch_bag) and travel bags (travel_bags_luggage).

keyrings_tags.definition: Decorative charms or tags attached to keys, bags, or phones.
keyrings_tags.boundary: Includes keyrings, bag charms, and phone charms; excludes jewellery and trinket boxes (trinket_jewellery_box).

kitchen_storage.definition: Containers such as tins, jars, and bread bins used to store food or kitchen items.
kitchen_storage.boundary: Includes biscuit tins, glass jars, and bread bins; excludes decorative storage boxes (trinket_jewellery_box) and baskets (storage_baskets_decor).

kitchen_textiles.definition: Fabric items used in the kitchen for cleaning, drying, and protection, such as tea towels, aprons, and oven gloves.
kitchen_textiles.boundary: Includes tea towels and oven gloves; excludes bath towels (bath_beauty) and table linens.

kitchen_tools.definition: Handheld tools and utensils used for cooking, serving, or eating.
kitchen_tools.boundary: Includes spoons, spatulas, chopsticks, and small pans; excludes baking-specific tools (baking_tools), kitchen storage (kitchen_storage), and tableware (plates, mugs_cups).

lights_lamps.definition: Lighting products including string lights, lamps, and lampshades for illumination or decoration.
lights_lamps.boundary: Includes fairy lights and lampshades; excludes candle holders (candle_holder_lantern) and non-electric lanterns.

lunch_bag.definition: Insulated or non-insulated bags designed to carry packed meals and snacks.
lunch_bag.boundary: Includes lunch bags with handles or zippers; excludes jumbo shopper bags (jumbo_shopper_bag) and lunch boxes (lunch_box_cutlery).

lunch_box_cutlery.definition: Containers for packed meals, often with accompanying mini cutlery sets.
lunch_box_cutlery.boundary: Includes lunchboxes with cutlery and standalone mini cutlery sets; excludes lunch bags (lunch_bag) and full-size kitchen utensils (kitchen_tools).

magnets.definition: Decorative magnets designed to attach to refrigerators or other magnetic surfaces.
magnets.boundary: Includes fridge magnets in sets or singles; excludes magnetic hooks or tools.

mirrors.definition: Reflective surfaces for viewing oneself, available as wall-mounted or handheld/compact styles.
mirrors.boundary: Includes wall mirrors and compact mirrors; excludes photo frames (photo_frame_album) and mirrored wall art (wall_art).

mugs_cups.definition: Drinking vessels intended for hot beverages such as tea and coffee.
mugs_cups.boundary: Includes mugs, coffee cups, and saucers; excludes teapots/coffee pots (teapot_tea_set) and disposable paper cups (party_tableware).

notebooks_journals.definition: Bound paper products for writing, note-taking, or sketching.
notebooks_journals.boundary: Includes notebooks, journals, and sketchbooks; excludes greeting cards and stationery sets.

party_bags_supplies.definition: Disposable or decorative items for parties, including party bags, balloons, invitations, and candy cones.
party_bags_supplies.boundary: Includes party favours and decorations; excludes party tableware (party_tableware) and bunting/garlands (bunting_garland).

party_tableware.definition: Disposable paper or plastic tableware for parties, such as napkins, plates, and cups.
party_tableware.boundary: Includes paper napkins and paper cups; excludes reusable plates (plates) and party bags/supplies (party_bags_supplies).

pens_pencils_art.definition: Writing and drawing instruments and related art materials.
pens_pencils_art.boundary: Includes pencils, pens, and erasers; excludes notebooks (notebooks_journals) and craft kits (sewing_craft).

pet_items.definition: Items for pets, particularly feeding bowls and related accessories.
pet_items.boundary: Includes dog and cat bowls; excludes human kitchen storage (kitchen_storage) and garden decor (garden_outdoor).

photo_frame_album.definition: Frames for displaying photographs and albums for storing them.
photo_frame_album.boundary: Includes photo frames and photo albums; excludes mirrors (mirrors) and wall art (wall_art).

plates.definition: Flat or shallow dishes used for serving or eating food.
plates.boundary: Includes dinner plates, cake plates, and pizza plates; excludes cake stands (cake_stand) and disposable paper plates (party_tableware).

tableware_sets.definition: Decorative accessories for table settings, such as napkin charms, napkin rings, and place card holders.
tableware_sets.boundary: Includes napkin rings and place setting decorations; excludes actual plates/cutlery (plates, kitchen_tools) and party tableware.

purse_wallet.definition: Small bags or cases used to carry money, cards, or cosmetics.
purse_wallet.boundary: Includes purses, wallets, and cosmetic pouches; excludes jumbo shopper bags (jumbo_shopper_bag) and keyring charms (keyrings_tags).

sewing_craft.definition: Kits and supplies for sewing, felt craft, and similar handmade projects.
sewing_craft.boundary: Includes sewing kits and felt doll kits; excludes art supplies (pens_pencils_art) and finished textile products.

door_hangers_signs.definition: Decorative signs, number tiles, and door hangers used for identification or display.
door_hangers_signs.boundary: Includes number/letter tiles and door signs; excludes wall art (wall_art) and hanging ornaments (hanging_ornaments).

travel_bags_luggage.definition: Bags and cases designed for travel, including cabin bags, airline bags, and picnic bags.
travel_bags_luggage.boundary: Includes luggage and travel bags; excludes jumbo shopper bags (jumbo_shopper_bag) and lunch bags (lunch_bag).

stickers_tattoos.definition: Adhesive decorative stickers and temporary tattoos for personalising items or skin.
stickers_tattoos.boundary: Includes paper and 3D stickers; excludes gift wrap/tags (gift_wrap_tags) and magnets (magnets).

teapot_tea_set.definition: Teapots, coffee pots, and matching cups/saucers or caddies used for serving tea or coffee.
teapot_tea_set.boundary: Includes tea/coffee pots and coordinated serving sets; excludes individual mugs (mugs_cups) not part of a set and kitchen storage jars (kitchen_storage).

tissues_plasters.definition: Disposable paper tissues and adhesive bandages for personal hygiene and first aid.
tissues_plasters.boundary: Includes pocket tissue packs and plasters; excludes bath sponges (bath_beauty) and kitchen towels (kitchen_textiles).

trinket_jewellery_box.definition: Decorative boxes used to store small items such as jewellery, sewing supplies, or tissues.
trinket_jewellery_box.boundary: Includes jewellery boxes, sewing boxes, and tissue box covers; excludes kitchen storage containers (kitchen_storage) and gift boxes (gift_boxes).

umbrella_rainwear.definition: Umbrellas and parasols used for protection from rain or sun, or as decorative accessories.
umbrella_rainwear.boundary: Includes folding umbrellas and decorative parasols; excludes raincoats and other clothing (clothing_slippers).

vases_planters.definition: Containers for displaying cut flowers or growing plants, including wall planters.
vases_planters.boundary: Includes vases, plant pots, and planters; excludes garden outdoor decor (garden_outdoor) and candle holders.

word_blocks_letters.definition: Decorative wooden letters or words used for display on shelves, walls, or tables.
word_blocks_letters.boundary: Includes freestanding or wall-mountable wooden letters/words; excludes door signs (door_hangers_signs) and wall art (wall_art).

wall_art.definition: Decorative pieces designed to be mounted on walls, including mirrored art and plaques.
wall_art.boundary: Includes wall plaques and mirrored wall art; excludes mirrors (mirrors) and hanging ornaments (hanging_ornaments).
